intent: Payments screen for the finance admin of Northgate Timber Ltd (business current account ···· 8842): read today's cash position, understand the month's coverage, action payments awaiting approval, scan what's scheduled ahead.

rulesRatified.flatness: flat in sober+balanced; expressive may use the derived elevation/gradient ramp (ramp not yet minted — promotion queue)
rulesRatified.inverseSurface: inverse/surface role permitted (balanced's one bold moment; token not yet minted — promotion queue)
rulesRatified.redForward: sober: red = destructive/accent only; balanced+expressive: red may lead the primary action
rulesRatified.radius: square in ALL registers — rounding forbidden (rounded system = future variant, not a register privilege)

fixed.rule: Univers + the ramp; reference the step, not the px (TScale)
AA contrast, focus-visible ring, target size, required ARIA per meta
high-value approval (£45,200 payroll) requires a confirmation step — no one-click; account refs masked last-4; sort codes fully masked
choreography free, expressed through canon easing tokens (--spring, --press)

flex: composition, grid, page template (canon has no template layer — always inferred)
data-viz encoding — on a canon data palette (G7: palette not yet minted; derive-and-flag)
columns/states/groupings a finance admin genuinely needs (structural licence, brief §1)

figures.$rule: verbatim from brief §3 — never invent, alter, or round

rules.rule: same payee shows same amount everywhere
coverage statement equals the maths; scheduled total equals sum of rows
account refs last-4 only; sort codes fully masked
no all-caps labels (house rule — overrides any styling convention)

blocking: compose — 0 rogue hex, all tokens resolve

promotion.policy: new values derived from fixed primitives, flagged as candidates, queued via _PROMOTION-QUEUE.md; winner's judgment enters canon (tokenise → meta → gated reference)
